We do not trade on the platforms we review and we take no referral position in the verdict. We read the pages, verify what is verifiable, and score what remains.
whatItClaims: Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$300 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
whatWeChecked: The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.
The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.
The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.
The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Complete the short signup form and click the confirmation link in your inbox.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Transfer the US$300 minimum - the sum stays in your trading balance, it is not a fee.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your risk settings, choose automatic or manual mode, and keep the demo running while you learn.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
redFlags: No regulator, licence or audit named anywhere.
Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.

faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$300 minimum.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: The verdict on the product is cautious approval: it works, it includes a demo, and it should be used with the minimum deposit while the claims are unproven.
The scorecard settles at 4.6. That is a cautious pass - proceed with the demo first, the minimum deposit second, and treat every payout figure as unproven until you see it yourself.
